cells.gaps: No row says the National Digitalization Policy text is public, and its scope is not described by any source. A National Digital Economy Strategy 2023-2028 is also held (adopted per MWI-025, awaiting Cabinet in MWI-028; may be the same document). A National Digital Transformation Strategy is in validation (draft, February 2026; MWI-004, 006, 008) with a proposed council and donor finance only. No delivery plan or reporting on record.
cells.note: Instrument: National Digitalization Policy 2023-2028, approved by Cabinet and inside its period, but no public text has been found, so stage 2 with text unpublished. Stage 3 needs a public text.
